title: Fractured Cinema
description: A woman in a long green velvet dress and glasses stands in a dilapidated room, holding a film reel in one hand and a film strip in the other. The wall behind her is cracked open like torn paper, revealing a cosmic scene with floating vintage film projectors and a starry night sky visible through tall arched windows.
prompt: A woman wearing glasses and an elegant emerald green velvet dress stands in a decaying room with cracked floors and arched windows showing a starry night. She holds a film reel and a long strip of film. The wall is dramatically torn open like old paper, revealing a cosmic blue space with multiple floating antique film projectors connected by brass mechanisms, cinematic surrealism, detailed textures, moody lighting
